extractions.value: deltoideus, biceps brachii, flexor carpi radialis, thenar muscles, lumbar paraspinal muscles, gluteus maximus, hamstrings, quadriceps, tibialis anterior, gastrocnemius-soleus complex, triceps surae, vastus medialis, abductor digiti minimi
extractions.quote: The following muscles were bilaterally examined: deltoideus, biceps brachii, flexor carpi radialis, thenar muscles, lumbar paraspinal muscles, gluteus maximus, hamstrings, quadriceps, tibialis anterior and gastrocnemius-soleus complex. ... To a lesser extent CMUA was also present in tibialis anterior and triceps surae muscles. ... EMG responses were recorded from biceps brachii (BB), abductor digiti minimi (ADM), tibialis anterior (TA) and vastus medialis (VM) muscles

extractions.value: Nerve conduction studies (NCS) were performed with supramaximal percutaneous nerve stimulation and surface electrode recording... Electromyography (EMG) was performed using a pair of 10-mm diameter Ag/Ag Cl electrodes placed 2-4 cm apart longitudinally over the muscle bellies and standard Medelec concentric needle electrodes. ... Long latency reflexes (LLRs) were elicited in leg muscles according to previously described methods [10]. ... Noninvasive magnetic stimulation of the brain and spinal roots was performed according to the procedures suggested by Rossini et al. [11]... Cortical stimulation was performed at 40% above each muscle resting motor threshold (T).

extractions.value: Patient had high titers of anti-GAD65 antibodies in both serum and CSF. TMS revealed a distinctive motor evoked potential (MEP) pattern in proximal lower limb muscles consisting of markedly increased MEP amplitudes and MEP/M ratios, reduced excitability thresholds, and absent silent period. Treatment with benzodiazepine and baclofen normalized both the clinical picture and the MEP values.
